newsVersionExact: California made SB 1168 and AB 1577 law on September 21.
actualMeaningExact: Neither law gives households an immediate bill credit or proves that electricity rates will fall.
mechanismExact: The law starts work inside a new or existing commission proceeding. It does not select a tariff, calculate a household saving or show how a particular utility will divide costs.
familiarExampleExact: For an electricity-bill claim, look for the later commission proceeding and an approved rate — not the signing headline alone.
